scripts.dev: mkdir -p ../web/dist && npm run db:migrate:local && wrangler dev --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8787 --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.deploy:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env production && wrangler deploy --env production
